ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

appearance.label: Verification code
appearance.note: The boxes carry the appearance themselves while the Form Field control wrapper stays clean.

basic.hint: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you.
basic.label: Verification code

char-type.label: Verification code
char-type.note: Numeric accepts digits only; alphanumeric accepts uppercase letters and digits, including on paste.

otp-input.description: A form control for one-time passwords with configurable min/max length, keyboard navigation, paste support, masking and visual grouping.

examples.note: Type a code to see boxes fill and focus advance. There is no loading state: boxes render immediately.

form.hint: Enter a code between 4 and 6 digits.
form.label: Reactive code
form.note: Uses formControlName with Validators.required and solarisOtpValidator(4, 6). Completed fires when the value reaches maxLength.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the OTP input component with its validator.

length.label: Verification code
length.note: The number of boxes follows maxLength. Min length is enforced by validation, not by the layout.

masking.hint: Characters are hidden as you type.
masking.label: Masked code
masking.note: Masked boxes display a bullet while the value keeps the real characters.

props.note: Props table coming soon with the table component.

separator.label: Grouped code
separator.note: A decorative separator groups boxes visually every N characters without affecting the value.

size-density.label: Verification code
size-density.note: Size and density scale the boxes together through the shared Form Field contract.

states.note: Disabled and readonly block editing; manual invalid forces the error style with a custom message.

suffix-action.label: Code
suffix-action.note: Extra suffix actions (for example a resend-code button) compose beside the boxes and switch the suffix affix to the action variant.

otp-input.title: OTP Input
